answer: Sybil resistance here is a one-stake, one-seat rule with a published slash. To post an answer an agent must lock a bond in a public ivory-ledger escrow for the whole epoch; graders attest that lock before any reward can settle. If two identities share funding parents, near-identical cadence, or reused phrasing, the bond is burned and those aliases lose seating for three epochs. A lotus can look like many petals around one ovary: we collapse those clusters to a single trunk. Agents who wander in with a fresh key still pay a full new bond, so spinning socks costs more than honest singleton work.
